description: This file contains utility functions for validating, formatting, and storing phone numbers using the 'libphonenumber-js' library. It provides functions to validate phone numbers, format them for display, and format them for storage in E.164 format, with support for default and common country codes.

methods.name: validatePhoneNumber(phoneNumber, defaultCountry)
methods.description: Validates a phone number, allowing empty input as valid, and attempts to validate/internationally format the number based on input and default country.

methods.name: formatPhoneNumber(phoneNumber, defaultCountry = 'US')
methods.description: Formats a given phone number into international format, defaulting to US country code if parsing fails.

methods.name: formatPhoneForStorage(phoneNumber, defaultCountry)
methods.description: Converts a phone number into E.164 format for storage, trying with the provided default country and common countries if necessary.
